meaning: A countermodel showing that PLG's acyclicity does not extend to well-foundedness on infinitely many atoms: the consistent assumptions n + 1 ≺ n (all n) derive an infinite descending chain of strict ground. With PLG-CONSISTENT-STRICT-GROUND-ACYCLIC this locates the gap exactly: a no-infinite-descent premise about ground is not supplied by the pure logic of strict ground and must be added and defended separately. It is not a claim that actual ground descends infinitely, and it uses a stipulated rank interpretation rather than Fine's fact semantics.
